rules.title: Outbound HTTP request to a URL from the request
rules.description: A request-controlled URL lets an attacker aim the server at internal services: cloud metadata endpoints, admin interfaces on localhost, or the internal network generally.
rules.remediation: Allowlist the hosts you intend to reach, resolve the hostname and reject private/link-local addresses, and disable redirects.

rules.title: Cloud instance metadata address referenced
rules.description: The link-local metadata service hands out instance credentials to anything that can reach it. Its presence in source is worth a look, and it is the first place an SSRF gets pointed.
rules.remediation: Require IMDSv2 (token-bound), and block outbound access to 169.254.0.0/16 from application containers.

rules.title: Redirects followed on an attacker-influenced request
rules.description: An allowlist check on the first URL is worthless if the client then follows a 302 to an internal address.
rules.remediation: Disable automatic redirects and re-validate each hop.

rules.title: Redirect target taken from the request
rules.description: An open redirect turns your domain into a credible starting point for a phishing link, and frequently bypasses OAuth redirect_uri checks.
rules.remediation: Redirect only to relative paths, or to an allowlist of absolute URLs.
